literal: However much / even if thought / he will not be angry; / that much / is it not / lover / doing / special favor.
translation: However much I think of him, he does not grow angry. Is that not the special favor my lover grants me?
modern: நான் எவ்வளவு நினைத்தாலும் அவர் என் மீது கோபப்பட மாட்டார். காதலர் எனக்குச் செய்யும் சிறப்பு அவ்வளவு பெரியது அல்லவா?
explanation: The speaker marvels at her lover's patience and grace. She constantly dwells on him, and while such relentless attention might normally cause annoyance, he never grows angry with her. She sees this boundless tolerance as a profound gift. The word 'சிறப்பு' (special favor or excellence) emphasizes that she views his refusal to be angered by her endless thoughts as a unique and cherished privilege granted by him.
